gloss: to transfer in; to move in (to a new jurisdiction)

definitions.gloss: to transfer in; to move in (to a new area or school)
definitions.explanation: To officially register as a new resident in a municipality, or to transfer into a new school. Used in administrative and educational contexts for formal relocation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{大阪|おおさか}→大阪：09779_oosaka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{転入|てんにゅう}した。
examples.english: I transferred my residence from Tokyo to Osaka.

examples.japanese: ⟦{転入|てんにゅう}{届|とどけ}→転入届：09811_tennyuutodoke⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{市役所|しやくしょ}→市役所：03067_shiyakusho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|だ}して→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please submit the transfer-in notification at the city hall.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{転入|てんにゅう}した⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧で、⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧がいない。
examples.english: I just transferred to a new school, so I don't have any friends yet.

notes:
An administrative term for officially moving into a new municipality or transferring into a new school. When moving between municipalities in Japan, residents must file a ⟦{転入|てんにゅう}{届|とどけ}→転入届：09811_tennyuutodoke⟧ (transfer-in notification) at their new city hall within 14 days.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{転入|てんにゅう}{届|とどけ}→転入届：09811_tennyuutodoke⟧: transfer-in notification
- ⟦{転入|てんにゅう}→転入：22235_tennyuu⟧⟦{届出|とどけで}→届出：07555_todokede⟧: filing of transfer-in notification
- ⟦{転入|てんにゅう}→転入：22235_tennyuu⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧: transfer-in procedures
- ⟦{転入|てんにゅう}{生|せい}→転入生：25867_tennyuusei⟧: transfer student
- ⟦{転入|てんにゅう}→転入：22235_tennyuu⟧⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧: new resident

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{転出|てんしゅつ}する→転出する：26918_tenshutsusuru⟧: to transfer out — the opposite; officially leaving a municipality
- ⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}す→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧: to move (house) — the everyday word for physically relocating, without the administrative nuance
- ⟦{転校|てんこう}する→転校する：25400_tenkousuru⟧: to change schools — specifically for school transfers
